name: Pip: Download Wheelhouse
description: Download a requirements file and all dependencies into a folder (a wheelhouse) for installing offline later. Can target another OS/Python, writes a SHA-256 manifest, and can zip it for transfer.

parameters.name: requirements
parameters.label: Requirements file
parameters.help: Path to requirements.txt on the machine that runs this script.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.label: Target platform
parameters.help: Leave “none” to download for this machine. Pick the OS of the offline machine if it differs; only binary wheels can be fetched for another platform.

parameters.name: python_version
parameters.label: Target Python version
parameters.help: Python on the offline machine, e.g. 3.11. Leave empty to use this interpreter's version.

parameters.name: only_binary
parameters.label: Binary wheels only
parameters.help: Refuse source packages (they would need compilers offline).
